title: LG proposes Veshow Archive to preserve Kashmir’s cultural heritage

ai.summary: Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha proposed a Veshow Archive to preserve Kashmir's oral history and cultural heritage, alongside mobile libraries and writers' residencies, during the Veshow Festival inauguration in Kulgam.

facts.claim: proposed setting up a Veshow Archive to preserve Kashmir’s oral history, folk tales and poetry
facts.quote: Lieutenant Governor (LG) Manoj Sinha on Wednesday proposed setting up a Veshow Archive to preserve Kashmir’s oral history, folk tales and poetry

facts.claim: establishing mobile libraries and writers’ residencies to take the region’s literary heritage to a wider audience
facts.quote: establishing mobile libraries and writers’ residencies to take the region’s literary heritage to a wider audience

facts.claim: the festival has evolved into a platform for literary exchange, creativity and cultural dialogue
facts.quote: Launched in 2023, the festival has evolved into a platform for literary exchange, creativity and cultural dialogue

facts.claim: the festival celebrates the region’s literary and cultural heritage
facts.quote: Named after the Veshow Stream, a major tributary of the Jhelum, the festival celebrates the region’s literary and cultural heritage

ai.background_note: The Veshow Festival, launched in 2023, has been used to promote Kashmir's cultural heritage through literary exchanges and creative dialogues, with the LG proposing new initiatives to expand its impact.
